description: This file provides asynchronous functions for fetching and caching GitHub user profile insights, including repository statistics and top languages, interacting with a database and external GitHub API.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: Database model representing cached user profile insights, including user details, stats, and last update timestamp.

classes.name: ActivityLog
classes.description: Database model for logging user search activities and request latencies.

methods.name: int _compute_total_stars(repos: list[dict])
methods.description: Calculates the total number of stars from a list of repositories.

methods.name: Dict[str,int] _compute_top_languages(repos: list[dict])
methods.description: Computes the most common programming languages across the repositories.

methods.name: Tuple[Dict[str,Any],Dict[str,Optional[str]]] get_profile_insights( session: AsyncSession, username: str )
methods.description: Main function to get or fetch and cache detailed insights for a given GitHub username, using caching and external API calls.
